file.description: The calendar file this manifest describes, in the same directory.

source.description: Where the calendar comes from; equal to the directory name.

client.description: The application that wrote the file, as its PRODID or the export says.

clientVersion.description: The version of that application, or null if unknown.

exported.description: The month of the export, YYYY-MM.

origin.description: Whose calendar it is and on what grounds it is here (own calendar, consent of its owner).

charset.description: The encoding of the file as exported; the parser must detect exactly this one.

lineEndings.description: The line endings of the file.

events.description: The number of VEVENT components in the file.

anonymizerCheck.description: The anonymizer's own check of this file.

license.description: The real corpus belongs to whoever exported it and stays out of the repository.

features.description: What is interesting about the file, without any of its values.
